Therefore, when a people's court determines the interest rate ceiling for an entrusted loan contract, it should refer to the relevant rules for private lending.

In this case, Hou Chuxiong entrusted SPDB to grant a loan to Mediterranean Hotel, which constitutes a legal relationship of entrusted loan. The lender SPDB filed this lawsuit as plaintiff based on relevant judicial interpretations, which does not affect the determination of the interest rate ceiling for the entrusted loan involved by referring to the relevant rules for private lending. The Entrusted Loan Contract in this case was signed on October 18, 2011, and SPDB disbursed the RMB 120 million loan to Mediterranean Hotel on October 25 and 26, 2011. When the Provisions on Private Lending (2015) came into effect on September 1, 2015, the second instance of this case had not yet concluded. According to Article 3 of the Supreme People's Court Notice on Earnest Study and Application of the Provisions on Private Lending, which states that for cases where the first instance, second instance, or retrial has not been concluded after the implementation of these Provisions, the judicial interpretations in effect before the implementation of these Provisions shall apply, and these Provisions shall not apply. Therefore, this case should not refer to the Provisions on Private Lending (2015), but should refer to the Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Adjudicating Private Lending Cases (hereinafter referred to as the Private Lending Opinions) that were effective at the time the loan in question was made. Article 7 of the Private Lending Opinions stipulates that the interest rate of private lending shall not exceed four times the benchmark interest rate of banks of the same category. These Opinions did not impose restrictions on whether the lender can simultaneously claim interest, penalty interest, and compound interest or on their respective caps. However, both the standard of "four times the benchmark interest rate of the same category" in the Private Lending Opinions and the standard of "annual interest rate of 24%" in the Provisions on Private Lending (2015) are the judicial protection caps for private lending interest rates determined by the people's courts in different periods, serving the same regulatory function. Considering that Articles 28 and 30 of the Provisions on Private Lending (2015) establish the rule that the annual interest rate of 24% is the judicial protection cap when interest, compound interest, penalty interest, and other expenses coexist, and according to Article 29 of the Supreme People's Court Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (II), where interest, penalty interest, compound interest, etc., in private lending before the implementation of the Provisions on Private Lending (2015) were obviously excessive and the party requested a reduction, the sum of interest and other charges for the same period should not exceed four times the benchmark interest rate of banks of the same category, and amounts exceeding that portion shall not be protected.

The original judgment determined the interest and penalty interest claimed by SPDB as follows: Mediterranean Hotel shall pay interest calculated at an annual rate of 24% for the loan period from November 21, 2011, to April 25, 2012 (including that day), thereafter penalty interest calculated at 50% above the loan interest rate, i.e., an annual rate of 36%, and from December 21, 2011 (including that day), compound interest on deferred interest calculated at the penalty interest rate, i.e., an annual rate of 36%. Accordingly, the sum of interest, penalty interest, and compound interest for the same period in this case has exceeded four times the benchmark interest rate of banks of the same category. The Enforcement Ruling (2017) Yue 03 Zhi No. 2000 made by the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court on July 6, 2017, which sealed the property of Mediterranean Hotel and others up to RMB 807,133,353, although possibly due to calculation reasons in enforcement, is not unrelated to the substantial imbalance of interests between the lending and borrowing parties caused by the substantive judgment. The original judgment indeed violated the relevant provisions of the above-mentioned private lending judicial interpretations and should be adjusted. As stated above, the sum of interest, penalty interest, and compound interest for the same period in this case has exceeded the judicial protection cap, i.e., four times the benchmark interest rate of banks of the same category. Therefore, itemizing them separately has no substantive meaning. Considering the contract terms and the performance situation, this court determines that the sum of the above interest, penalty interest, and compound interest shall be calculated at four times the benchmark interest rate of banks of the same category for the same period, and amounts exceeding that portion shall not be protected. Mediterranean Hotel's retrial request to adjust the loan interest involved in the case is established, and this court supports it.

Furthermore, regarding Mediterranean Hotel's claim to deduct the amount of financing consulting service fees charged by a third party to it within the scope of the interest in this case, this court is of the opinion that the charging of financing consulting service fees by the third party in connection with the loan in this case is not the same legal relationship as the entrusted loan in this case. Moreover, Mediterranean Hotel cannot prove that the interest collected by Hou Chuxiong and the financing consulting service fees collected by the third party are attributable to the same entity. Therefore, this court does not support Mediterranean Hotel's claim.

In summary, Mediterranean Hotel's retrial request is partially established, and this court supports it. The second-instance judgment found clear facts but applied the law incorrectly. This court corrects it. Pursuant to Article 29 of the Supreme People's Court Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (II), Article 207(1) and Article 170(1)(2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. The Civil Judgment (2015) Yue Gao Fa Min Si Zhong Zi No. 170 of the Guangdong High People's Court is vacated;

2. Items 1, 3, and 4 of the Civil Judgment (2012) Shen Zhong Fa She Wai Chu Zi No. 50 of the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court are affirmed;

3. Item 2 of the Civil Judgment (2012) Shen Zhong Fa She Wai Chu Zi No. 50 of the Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court is modified as follows: Meizhou Mediterranean Hotel Co., Ltd. shall, within fifteen days from the effective date of this judgment, pay to Shanghai Pudong Development Bank Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Branch the loan principal of RMB 120,000,000 and interest thereon (interest calculated on the principal of RMB 120,000,000 at four times the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same category and same period published by the People's Bank of China, from November 21, 2011, to the date of full payment);

4. Other claims of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank Co., Ltd., Shenzhen Branch are dismissed.

If the obligated party fails to perform the monetary payment obligation within the period specified in this judgment, it shall double the interest on the debt for the period of delayed performance in accordance with Article 253 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.
